17027               	; 	INCLUDE "art.bas"
17028               	; 	' Keystone Kapers art -- GENERATED by assets/genart.py. Do not edit; regenerate.
17029               	; 	'
17030               	; 	' EVERY SPRITE IS 16x16: sprite size and magnification are GLOBAL on the
17031               	; 	' TMS9918, so small objects are drawn small INSIDE a 16x16 box rather than
17032               	; 	' being small sprites.
17033               	; 	'
17034               	; 	' EVERY 8-PX OBJECT SITS IN ROWS 8-15 OF ITS BOX, ducked Kelly included, so
17035               	; 	' one rule places them all: bottom edge = y + 16, and a thing resting on the
17036               	; 	' floor is at y = FLOORY - 16.
17037               	; 	'
17038               	; 	' Sprite bytes are QUADRANT-ORDERED: 16 rows of the left half, then 16 of
17039               	; 	' the right. Every block is an EVEN number of bytes -- an odd DATA BYTE run
17040               	; 	' silently misaligns every word table after it (CLAUDE.md 3A).
17041               	;
17042               	; spr_kelly:	' Kelly: RIGHT hat/face/the four merged run bodies/duck hat/face/body, then the same LEFT (+36). The run bodies carry tunic AND legs, so a frame is one sprite. Patterns 0..68
17043               cvb_SPR_KELLY

18283               	; 	INCLUDE "store.bas"
18284               	; 	' Keystone Kapers store -- GENERATED by assets/genstore.py. Do not edit.
18285               	; 	'
18286               	; 	' EIGHT band templates of 5 rows x 32 cols (160 bytes each) plus a 32-byte
18287               	; 	' index over (level, screen). The whole 8-screen, 4-level building is about
18288               	; 	' 1.3 KB instead of the 5,120 bytes it would cost to store literally.
18289               	; 	'
18290               	; 	' All eight templates are ONE contiguous block under ONE label, so a band
18291               	; 	' blit is
18292               	; 	'     SCREEN stor_tpl, tpl*160, toprow*32, 32, 5, 32
18293               	; 	' with no label ladder -- SCREEN needs a literal label and a label cannot be
18294               	; 	' chosen by a variable, which is why RallyX needed a 4-way IF over its maze
18295               	; 	' tables. One block sidesteps it.
18296               	; 	'
18297               	; 	' 160 is EVEN, so this cannot leave the location counter odd and misalign
18298               	; 	' the word tables defined after it.
18299               	; 	'
18300               	; 	' template ids:
18301               	; 	'   0 T_AISLE_A
18302               	; 	'   1 T_AISLE_B
18303               	; 	'   2 T_ESC_W
18304               	; 	'   3 T_ESC_E
18305               	; 	'   4 T_ELEV
18306               	; 	'   5 T_ROOF0
18307               	; 	'   6 T_ROOF1
18308               	; 	'   7 T_ROOF2
18309               	; 	'   8 T_ROOF3
18310               	; 	'   9 T_ROOF4
18311               	; 	'   10 T_ROOF5
18312               	; 	'   11 T_ROOF6
18313               	; 	'   12 T_ROOF7
18314               	; 	'   13 T_END_W
18315               	; 	'   14 T_END_E
18316               	;
18317               	; stor_tpl:	' 15 templates x 160 bytes
18318               cvb_STOR_TPL

18933               	;
18934               	; 	' THE SKYLINE'S LAST BAND WITHOUT ITS YELLOW, high nibble ink, low nibble
18935               	; 	' paper, one byte a scan line -- the same shape genart emits into
18936               	; 	' store_col. SKY2 is white-on-9 throughout instead of turning to paper 10
18937               	; 	' at row 4; BLDGL holds its blue one row longer and then meets its own
18938               	; 	' grey wall. Both are the generated bytes with 10 replaced by 9 and
18939               	; 	' nothing else changed. See setup_rest.
18940               	; #if NES
18941               	; nes_sky2c:
18942               	; 	DATA BYTE $F9,$F9,$F9,$F9,$F9,$F9,$F9,$F9

18944               	; 	DATA BYTE $B9,$B9,$B9,$B9,$B9,$BE,$BE,$BE
18945               	; #endif
18946               	;
18947               	; 	' THE IN-GAME FONT'S COLOUR, one byte a scan line and eight a character for
18948               	; 	' all 59 of them. $F4 is white on dark blue -- ink index 3, paper index 1 --
18949               	; 	' and which colours those are is then the attribute table's business, per
18950               	; 	' region: dark blue behind the HUD, the store's green behind a message box.
18951               	; 	'
18952               	; 	' 472 bytes of one repeated value. That reads like waste and is the cheap
18953               	; 	' option: ROM is three budgets here and this is not the scarce one, while
18954               	; 	' the alternative is a second font (impossible -- only eleven free codes)
18955               	; 	' or a new uploader parameter (no RAM -- two bytes left).
